findings.text: Mobile tap targets under 44px across the app shell
Serious colour-contrast violations on four screens (axe WCAG 2 AA)
HADAF progress bar has no accessible name
Money figures declare a Latin-only font stack, so Arabic-Indic digits fall back per device

notes: First UX-enabled run, before the plan existed. Recorded retroactively.

notes: Pass-5 fixes re-driven and confirmed; ledger/dashboard/HADAF agreed with the database.
